# 🚀 HOW TO REPLICATE THIS ANGLE FOR MAX AD SPEND
**1- Tell it as someone else's story:**
"Mi esposo sufría de una picazón que no lo dejaba tranquilo."
-# (My husband had an itch that wouldn't leave him alone.)
**2- Put the result first, then the story:**
"Los resultados son reales. Mira cómo está su cuero cabelludo ahora."
-# (The results are real. Look at his scalp now.)
**3- Show it on a real scalp:**
Apply, lather, leave it 2–3 minutes, rinse. Film close, in good light.
**4- Name what they're dealing with, in one line:**
"Caspa, picazón, resequedad: champú antifúngico con ketoconazol al 1%."
-# (Dandruff, itching, dryness: antifungal shampoo with 1% ketoconazole.)
**5- End with a question, then the cart:**
"¿A alguien más le pasa? Te lo dejo en el carrito naranja."
-# (Does this happen to anyone else? I'll leave it for you in the orange cart.)
**✅ Remake checklist:**
Someone else's story · Result first · Real scalp on camera · Product early · Question + cart at the end

**This one sold with zero ad spend. Make yours hold attention like this and the brand can put ads behind it.**
